name: What is the process for a full bathroom renovation with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a full bathroom renovation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and needs. We then create a detailed proposal and design plan. Once approved, we handle all aspects from demolition, plumbing, electrical, and structural work to tile installation, fixture placement, and final finishes. We maintain communication throughout the project, ensuring it stays on track and meets your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, proposal, design, demolition, construction, and finishing, with continuous communication.
